C-DECLARED-WRITES.Summary: Close F27 / F27.1 / F27.2: compare each change's durable WriteEvidence paths to its plan ObservedWriteScope at review time (distinct from the porcelain scope audit); raise on undeclared non-excluded writes including non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` paths; report absence when the ledger has nothing to compare; pin the archive ratchet (exactly two historical raises, exactly zero undeclared non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` paths); and prevent the forced-pin / forced-fixture omission class by teaching `ngrace-plan` that ObservedWriteScope covers what the deliverable forces, not only what it targets.
C-DECLARED-WRITES.Problem:
**F27 / F27.1 — ObservedWriteScope is declared and digested, but the durable record is never compared to the declaration** (decisions.md).
A comparison already exists. `review.scope-outside-write-scope` / `auditScopeOutsideWriteScope` is the mechanized §0.7.1 scope audit. Its input is the **git working tree** (`explicit | base | porcelain`). At close everything is committed, the tree is clean, and with no `--base` or `--changed-files` the audit reports:
``` Scope audit: not-run — no changed files available (working tree clean; supply --base or --changed-files) ```
That line appeared on `C-SUBSTANTIATION-HONESTY`'s own close. The check does not fail to exist — it declines to run, honestly, at the moment a verdict is formed.
Meanwhile `snapshotWriteEvidence` calls `listRepositoryChangedFiles` (the whole repository's changed set), digests every path, and records the result **per attempt**. The record is tool-generated (`git status`), survives fold and archive, and is exactly the evidence class F9.10.1 says can constrain an agent. **Nothing reads it for scope.**
Independent re-measure at this authoring HEAD (27 archived `C-*` bundles; union of WriteEvidence `File` paths vs plan `ObservedWriteScope` File/Path entries; exclude `.ngrace/**` for the F27.1 table only):
| metric | value | | bundles scanned | 27 | | bundles with ≥1 undeclared write | 3 | | undeclared path instances | 5 | | bundles with no evidence to compare | 11 (4 missing `run-ledger.xml`, 7 ledger with zero WriteEvidence) |
| bundle | undeclared path | class | | `C-ESCALATION-HONESTY` | `src/gates/core.test.ts` | true positive — disclosed and adjudicated (F27 / F27.2) | | `C-ESCALATION-HONESTY` | `docs/plans/…/decisions.md` | authority concurrent edit | | `C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY` | `docs/plans/…/decisions.md` | authority concurrent edit | | `C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY` | `docs/plans/…/review.md` | authority concurrent edit | | `C-EXECUTION-CONTRACT` | `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` | true positive — undisclosed until F27.2 |
Matches F27.1's table exactly. Command and full enumeration live in Assumptions.
**Non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` (not in F27.1's table).** F27.1 excluded every `.ngrace/` path and never looked. Independent re-measure comparing WriteEvidence paths under `.ngrace/` that are **not** `isCliLifecyclePath` matches against OWS (with active↔archive identity):
``` undeclared non-lifecycle .ngrace/ writes across 27 archived bundles: 0 ```
Twenty-two non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` WriteEvidence paths exist in the corpus (plan.xml, spec.xml, graph/verification files); every one is in OWS. That is a held immutability / declaration discipline, not an empty set. An approved `spec.xml` is immutable and must never appear in WriteEvidence as an undeclared edit — if it does, that is among the most serious violations this methodology has. Pinning **exactly 0** undeclared non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` findings over the archive converts that intention into a regression.
**F27.2 — both historical breaches share one preventable shape.** Neither write was wrong, only undeclared. `C-EXECUTION-CONTRACT` changed skill text and forced the skill-footprint pin to move; `C-ESCALATION-HONESTY` changed a rule and forced a fixture that constructed that rule to change. By execute time the edit is forced — breach scope or fail the task. Both were decidable at plan-authoring time. A detector alone leaves every future plan free to make the same omission and merely learn at close. **Prevention belongs in `ngrace-plan`**, where ObservedWriteScope is authored — not in `ngrace-execute`, which obeys the declaration.

Goals.Goal: Add a **ledger-backed** scope comparison: for a resolved change, take the **union** of content paths recorded in WriteEvidence across the change's run ledger (folded events and any loose `run/` events still present), exclude the path classes named in Constraints, and raise one finding per remaining path that is **not** covered by the plan's ObservedWriteScope (File/Path exact membership and existing Glob matching — `observedWriteScopeContains` / the same expansion rules the porcelain audit uses, including archive-identity expansion for active↔archive plan paths when applicable).

**Distinct from the porcelain audit (decided).** Same declared-scope question, different evidence source. Finding code **locked** (exact string, F23): **`review.write-evidence-outside-scope`**. Export a single catalog constant (e.g. `WRITE_EVIDENCE_SCOPE_FINDING_CODE`) used by the emitter, catalog entry, suite pins, and skill agreement tests — do not re-type the string at call sites. Do **not** overload `review.scope-outside-write-scope` or silently feed WriteEvidence into `auditScopeOutsideWriteScope` as a second input that shares one code — when the two disagree the operator must tell which said what. Shared path-coverage helpers are fine; shared finding identity is not.

**Always report whether the ledger audit ran** (F31 class). Same vocabulary as scope / attempt-pair: `status: "ran" | "not-run" | "unable-to-determine"` with a reason. Unscoped review (no `--change`) → `not-run` (reason names missing `--change`). Change resolved but no comparable WriteEvidence (missing ledger, or ledger with zero WriteEvidence File digests) → **`unable-to-determine`**, never "clean." Change with at least one comparable path → `ran` (including zero findings). Text and JSON both surface the status; Findings: 0 must not read as "ledger scope audited clean" when status is `not-run` or `unable-to-determine`.

**Path-class exclusions (tool-defined, not agent-authored lists):** (1) CLI lifecycle paths already covered by `isCliLifecyclePath` (F11) — `run/**`, `run.xml`, `run-ledger.xml` under any canonical C-* bundle — **not** `spec.xml` or `plan.xml`; (2) **authority roadmap tree:** any path with prefix `docs/plans/`. Both are path-class rules, not per-bundle allowlists.

**Non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` paths raise when undeclared.** Approved artifacts (`spec.xml`, `plan.xml`) and other non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` paths that appear in WriteEvidence outside OWS are findings. Archive ratchet includes **exactly 0** such findings over every enumerated archive bundle (authoring measurement: 0; pin the invariant, not a directory count).

**Retroactive archive behaviour (decided):** the check runs for any resolved bundle — active **or** archive — that has comparable WriteEvidence. After exclusions, the authoring corpus yields **exactly two** raise instances on non-`.ngrace/` product paths (the two true positives) and **exactly zero** undeclared non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` raises. The suite pins those exact multisets as a **tool-side ratchet** (authored in tests by the check's implementers, not by the bundle under audit — passes F9.10.1). It does **not** pin "zero findings over the archive" for the product-path code. Permanent red on `ngrace review --change C-EXECUTION-CONTRACT` is accepted forensic honesty, not a close-time tax: **closes are change-scoped**, so the two historical findings never appear at any future close and the F11 "permanently red teaches ignore" harm does not apply.

**Severity error (decided).** An undeclared write that can reach archive undisclosed is not a style nit. Matches `review.scope-outside-write-scope` severity. Belongs on the **review** process-audit surface (visible at close), not the lint family.
Positive fixtures prove raise and silence independently of the archive ratchet (counterweight: a detector broken into permanent silence fails fixtures even if a soft corpus pin passed).

**Prevention half (F27.2):** surgically extend `skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md` and its packaged mirror so plan authors declare ObservedWriteScope for what the deliverable **forces**, not only what it targets. Name the live finding code (bound to the catalog constant) as the failure shape. Canonical and packaged remain byte-identical. This is product change on the skill that authors the declaration — not on `ngrace-execute`.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LEDGER-SCOPE-RULE: When a change is resolved and comparable WriteEvidence exists, review raises **`review.write-evidence-outside-scope`** (severity **error**) for each path that (1) appears as a WriteEvidence content File path in the union across that change's ledger events, (2) is not an `isCliLifecyclePath` match, (3) does not have prefix `docs/plans/`, and (4) is not covered by the plan ObservedWriteScope under the same coverage rules the porcelain audit uses (exact File/Path, globs, archive-identity expansion). Lifecycle exclusion is **only** `run.xml` / `run-ledger.xml` / `run/**` under a valid C-* bundle — **not** `spec.xml`, `plan.xml`, graph, or verification paths. Non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` paths that appear in WriteEvidence outside OWS **raise**. Deduplicate by path: one finding per undeclared path per change, not one per attempt. **Values named:** code string `review.write-evidence-outside-scope`; severity error; union-not-per-attempt; exclusions lifecycle + `docs/plans/` only. **Failure conditions:** porcelain code reused for ledger hits; warning severity; per-attempt spam for the same path; lifecycle or `docs/plans/` paths raised; non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` undeclared path silent; OWS coverage ignored; only last-attempt intersection consulted.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-DISTINCT-FROM-PORCELAIN: `review.scope-outside-write-scope` continues to mean **working-tree / explicit / base** changed files only. Ledger hits use only `review.write-evidence-outside-scope`. Report lines name the audit so an operator can see both: existing Scope audit line unchanged in meaning; new WriteEvidence-scope audit line (exact label plan-owned; must be human-visible and present in JSON). A clean tree at close may show Scope audit `not-run` while WriteEvidence-scope audit `ran`. **Failure conditions:** single merged finding code; Scope audit line claims it consulted WriteEvidence; ledger-only breach reported under the porcelain code.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ABSENCE-RECORD: Process-audit review results always carry WriteEvidence-scope audit status. **no `--change`:** `not-run` with reason naming missing `--change`. **`--change` present, bundle unresolved:** `not-run` or `unable-to-determine` with reason (plan-owned; machine-checkable). **`--change` present, bundle resolved, zero comparable WriteEvidence File digests** (missing `run-ledger.xml` / unreadable ledger, or ledger present but no WriteEvidence paths): **`unable-to-determine`** with reason that states there is no WriteEvidence to compare — **not** `ran` with zero findings presented as clean. **`--change` present, ≥1 comparable path after lifecycle strip (exclusions may remove some):** `ran` (findingCount may be 0). Text and JSON both expose status. Unscoped Findings: 0 must not read as ledger-scope clean when status is `not-run` / `unable-to-determine` (same honesty bar as attempt-pair / scope). **Failure conditions:** eleven predating archive bundles score as clean `ran`; unscoped omits the audit entirely; empty WE reported as successful clean audit without absence.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-EXCLUSION-DOCS-PLANS: No finding with code `review.write-evidence-outside-scope` has a `file` (or primary path) under prefix `docs/plans/`. Suite proves: authority paths from the authoring measurement (`…/decisions.md`, `…/review.md` on the measured bundles) do **not** raise; removing the exclusion in a mutation probe reintroduces them. **Failure conditions:** `docs/plans/` path appears in findings; exclusion implemented as a one-off list of the three measured files only (must be the prefix class); exclusion accidentally swallows `src/`, skills, or non-lifecycle `.ngrace/`.

Against repository archives **at evaluation time** (dynamic enumeration of `.ngrace/changes/archive/C-*` — **no** `expect(dirs.length).toBe(N)` for authoring N; F33): for every enumerated bundle with status `ran`, the set of `review.write-evidence-outside-scope` findings equals the set difference (WriteEvidence paths − OWS − exclusions).
**Product / non-docs ratchet — exact multiset of `(changeId, path)`:**
- (`C-ESCALATION-HONESTY`, `src/gates/core.test.ts`) - (`C-EXECUTION-CONTRACT`, `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts`)
**No other pairs** among non-lifecycle, non-`docs/plans/` paths.

Authoring measurement (independent of F27.1's full-tree exclude): 0 undeclared non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` WriteEvidence paths across 27 bundles. This pin is a **regression on approved-artifact immutability / declaration**, not a directory-count pin. The day an undeclared edit to an approved `spec.xml` (or other non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` path) appears in archive WriteEvidence, this assertion goes red.
Bundles with `unable-to-determine` contribute zero findings and must appear in the audit status breakdown (not counted as clean rule passes). Ratchet pins are **suite-authored tool-side freezes** (F9.10.1 pass), not declarations inside the audited bundles. **Failure conditions:** product corpus asserted as zero findings; soft `toBeLessThan`; only dirty bundles scanned; product ratchet grows without intentional test edit; non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` count not pinned to exact 0; `toBe(27)` / `toBe(28)` on directory count; unable-to-determine omitted from status accounting.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-FIXTURES: Synthetic fixtures (not only live archive): **must raise** when WriteEvidence union contains `src/secret.ts` (or similar) and OWS does not; **must raise** when WriteEvidence contains an undeclared non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` path (e.g. active bundle `spec.xml` not in OWS); **must not raise** when every non-excluded WriteEvidence path is in OWS; **must not raise** when the only extras are lifecycle paths or `docs/plans/**`; **must** mark `unable-to-determine` when WE is empty. Positive raise fixtures are required as counterweight to both archive ratchets. **Failure conditions:** archive ratchet alone treated as proof; no forced raise for product path; no forced raise for undeclared non-lifecycle `.ngrace/`; empty WE fixture claims `ran` clean.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-HEAD-RED: At implementation red-first (before product edits): change-scoped review of `C-EXECUTION-CONTRACT` does **not** yet emit `review.write-evidence-outside-scope` for `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` (code absent). After the change, that review **does** emit exactly that finding (among any others the rule requires for that bundle). Proves the check is not already green on the unmodified tree for the load-bearing case (F28). **Failure conditions:** only synthetic fixtures prove raise; live undisclosed breach still silent after the change; test that would pass at pre-change HEAD.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-PLAN-FORCED-SCOPE:
Both `skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md` and `plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md` state a plan-authoring rule, in substance:
ObservedWriteScope must cover what the change's deliverable **forces**, not only the files it targets. A plan that alters **skill text** declares the skill-footprint pin (`src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` in this repository's layout, or the project's equivalent pin). A plan that alters a **rule** declares the fixtures that construct instances of that rule. More generally: if the approved deliverable makes an edit inevitable, that path is in ObservedWriteScope at plan time — an executor must not be left choosing between scope breach and task failure.
Failure shape for violating the duty the check enforces: **`review.write-evidence-outside-scope`**, bound to the exported catalog constant (presence via the constant / required substring built from it — not a free-typed literal that can drift). **How checked:** agreement tests (positive presence of live code from constant; negative absence of any retired/wrong code if introduced; substance of forced-scope rule present on **both** trees). Kind-set completeness alone does not satisfy this AC. **Failure conditions:** only execute skill edited; only canonical updated; code named as a retyped literal that can drift from catalog; rule stated without the failure-shape code; "declare what you target" left as the only OWS guidance.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-PROSE-ENFORCEMENT-AGREE: Both ngrace-plan skill trees contain the live finding code via the catalog constant binding (same pattern as `ATTEMPT_PAIR_FINDING_CODE` / C-SUBSTANTIATION-HONESTY T-002). Mutating the constant without the skill reddens; mutating either skill tree without the constant reddens; positive presence **and** negative absence (if any stale code is defined) on **both** paths. **Failure conditions:** only one tree checked; only presence or only absence; literal string in tests that would pass if the constant renamed and skill left stale.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SKILL-MIRROR-IDENTICAL: After the change, `skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md` and `plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md` are byte-identical (`git diff --no-index` clean / validate-marketplace packaged-vs-canonical green). **Failure conditions:** only canonical edited; drift left for later cleanup; eye-check without validator.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SUITE-AND-LINT: Red-first regressions cover each AC with exact assertions (F23). `bun test` green for touched packages; `bun run validate:ci` green (determinism ratchet cardinality only moves if a new review catch is intentionally added — do not silently drop keys); `bun run ./scripts/validate-marketplace.ts` green; `bun run ngrace lint --path .` is 0 errors and 0 warnings **at close** (after apply/archive — not claimed mid-change). No edits under `docs/plans/` or `.ngrace/changes/archive/`; no CHANGELOG.md; no version surfaces. Catalog cardinality pins updated for **add** of one review code if they assert an exact count (measured at plan time). `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts`: after skill prose lands, re-measure `skillTextLines().total`; pin exact `toBe` to measured value (F29 line-count honesty). If unchanged, leave pin and report re-measured; unchanged — file remains in OWS either way (F27). **Failure conditions:** suite red; lint 0/0 claimed mid-window; archive or decisions.md edits; version bump; new code unregistered; skill pin moved while total pin left stale; token-accounting left undeclared in plan OWS.
